en.name: Barbell Bench Press
setup: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar.
Plant your feet flat and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and unrack it over your chest.
execution: Lower the bar under control to your mid chest.
Keep your elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press the bar back up and slightly toward your face until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides.
Lifting the hips off the bench.
en.safety: Use a spotter or safety arms when you work close to failure.

en.name: Push-Up
setup: Place your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
execution: Bend your elbows and lower your chest until it nearly touches the floor.
Keep your elbows angled back, not flared wide.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag or pike up.
Doing half reps that stop well above the floor.
Dropping the head forward.

en.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
setup: Sit on the end of the bench with the dumbbells on your thighs.
Lie back and bring the dumbbells to the sides of your chest.
Set your feet and pull your shoulder blades together.
execution: Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your chest.
Lower them slowly until your elbows are just below the bench.
Keep your forearms vertical throughout.
mistakes: Clanging the dumbbells together at the top.
Letting the elbows drop far below the bench.
Dropping the dumbbells to the floor while the arms are still bent.

en.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
setup: Set the bench to an incline of 30 to 45 degrees.
Sit back with the dumbbells at the sides of your upper chest.
Pull your shoulder blades back against the bench.
execution: Press the dumbbells up over your upper chest.
Lower them under control until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your elbows slightly tucked.
mistakes: Setting the bench so steep it becomes a shoulder press.
Arching the lower back off the bench.

en.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
setup: Set the bench to 30 to 45 degrees and sit with your eyes under the bar.
Grip slightly wider than your shoulders and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Unrack the bar over your upper chest.
execution: Lower the bar to the top of your chest, just below the collarbones.
Press it back up in a straight line until your arms lock out.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Letting the hips leave the seat.
en.safety: Use a spotter or safety arms when you work close to failure.

en.name: Machine Chest Press
setup: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles.
execution: Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.
mistakes: Letting the shoulders roll forward at the end of each rep.
Letting the weight stack crash between reps.

en.name: Cable Crossover
setup: Set both pulleys above shoulder height and hold a handle in each hand.
Take a step forward and lean your torso slightly.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
execution: Bring the handles down and together in a wide arc in front of your hips.
Squeeze your chest for a moment.
Let your arms open slowly until you feel a stretch.
mistakes: Bending the elbows and turning it into a press.
Using momentum from the torso.

en.name: Dumbbell Fly
setup: Lie on a flat bench holding the dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that angle fixed.
execution: Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back up along the same arc.
mistakes: Lowering the dumbbells so far that the shoulders hurt.
Straightening the arms completely, which strains the elbows.
en.safety: Stop the stretch at shoulder level to protect the front of the shoulder.

en.name: Pec Deck
setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and grab the handles.
execution: Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Pause and squeeze, then let them open slowly until you feel a stretch.
mistakes: Letting the hands travel behind the body.
Rushing the return.

en.name: Chest Dip
setup: Grip the bars and jump up to support yourself with straight arms.
Lean your torso forward and bend your knees slightly.
execution: Lower yourself until your shoulders are slightly below your elbows.
Keep the forward lean and press back up to straight arms.
mistakes: Sinking too deep and straining the shoulders.
Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears.
en.safety: Stop the descent at a depth your shoulders tolerate without pain.

en.name: Dumbbell Pullover
setup: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
execution: Lower the dumbbell behind your head in an arc until you feel a stretch in your chest and lats.
Pull it back over your chest along the same arc.
mistakes: Bending the elbows so the move becomes a triceps extension.
Arching the lower back to reach further.

en.name: Incline Push-Up
setup: Place your hands on a bench, box or sturdy counter, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line.
execution: Lower your chest to the edge of the surface.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag.
Placing the hands too far forward of the shoulders.

en.name: Knee Push-Up
setup: Kneel and place your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Shift forward so your body is straight from knees to head.
execution: Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Bending at the hips instead of keeping a straight line.
Shortening the range of motion.
cues: Knees to head in one line

en.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
setup: Place a flat bench under the bar so it lines up with your mid chest.
Lie down, grip slightly wider than your shoulders and set your shoulder blades.
Set the safety stops just below the bar's lowest point.
Unhook the bar by rotating it.
execution: Lower the bar to your mid chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Positioning the bench so the bar lands on the neck or belly.
Forgetting to set the safety stops.

en.name: Decline Push-Up
setup: Place your feet on a bench or box and your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Brace so your body forms a straight line.
execution: Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Letting the lower back sag.
Placing the feet so high that the move becomes a shoulder press.

en.name: Wide-Grip Push-Up
setup: Place your hands about one and a half shoulder widths apart.
Step back into a straight plank.
execution: Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up while keeping your body straight.
mistakes: Placing the hands so wide that the shoulders hurt.
Letting the hips sag.

en.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
setup: Hook your legs under the pads of a decline bench and lie back.
Grip slightly wider than your shoulders and unrack the bar with help or carefully.
execution: Lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Unracking alone without control.
en.safety: Use a spotter; getting out from under a stuck bar on a decline is hard.

en.name: Machine Incline Chest Press
setup: Set the seat so the handles start level with your upper chest.
Sit back against the pad and grip the handles.
execution: Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly to the start.
mistakes: Pushing the head and shoulders forward off the pad.
Bouncing the weight stack.

en.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
setup: Set both pulleys at the lowest position and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a staggered stance and a slight bend in the elbows.
execution: Sweep your hands up and together to the height of your upper chest.
Lower them slowly along the same path.
mistakes: Lifting with the shoulders and shrugging.
Bending the arms into a curl.

en.name: Incline Smith Machine Press
setup: Place an incline bench under the bar so it lines up with your upper chest.
Set the safety stops just below the bar's lowest point.
Lie back, grip slightly wider than your shoulders and unhook the bar.
execution: Lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Lowering the bar to the neck.
Not setting the safety stops.

en.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
setup: Set the bench to about 30 degrees and lie back with the dumbbells above your chest.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
execution: Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your upper chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.
mistakes: Lowering too far and stressing the shoulders.
Pressing the weight instead of hugging it.

en.name: Clap Push-Up
setup: Start in a strong push-up position.
Brace your core so your body stays straight in the air.
execution: Lower quickly, then push so hard that your hands leave the floor.
Clap once and land with soft elbows.
Reset before the next rep if needed.
mistakes: Landing with locked elbows.
Letting the hips sag on the landing.
en.safety: Master the explosive push-up first, and stop when your landing gets sloppy.

en.name: Band Chest Press
setup: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold one end in each hand.
Step forward until the band is taut and stand in a staggered stance.
execution: Press your hands forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your hands are beside your chest.
mistakes: Leaning the torso forward to finish the rep.
Letting the band snap back.

en.name: Explosive Push-Up
setup: Start in a push-up position with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core so your body stays straight.
execution: Lower with control, then push up as fast as you can so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly and go straight into the next rep.
mistakes: Letting the body bend in the middle.
Landing hard on straight arms.

en.name: Cable Chest Press
setup: Set the pulleys at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a staggered stance with the handles beside your chest.
execution: Press the handles forward and slightly together until your arms are straight.
Return slowly to the start.
mistakes: Leaning forward to move the weight.
Letting the elbows drift above shoulder height.

en.name: Weighted Push-Up
setup: Get into a push-up position.
Have a partner place a weight plate flat on your upper back, or wear a weight vest.
execution: Lower your chest to the floor with the load steady.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag under the extra weight.
Letting the plate slide toward the neck.

en.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
setup: Hook your legs under the pads of a decline bench with a dumbbell on each thigh.
Lie back and bring the dumbbells to your lower chest.
execution: Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your lower chest.
mistakes: Letting the dumbbells drift toward the face.
Rushing the lowering.

en.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest your upper arms on the floor at about 45 degrees from your body.
execution: Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor lightly, then press again.
mistakes: Bouncing the elbows off the floor.
Flaring the elbows straight out.

en.name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
setup: Lie on a flat bench and hold two dumbbells together above your chest, palms facing each other.
Press the dumbbells firmly into each other.
execution: Lower the dumbbells to your chest while squeezing them together.
Press back up without letting them separate.
mistakes: Letting the dumbbells drift apart.
Using dumbbells too heavy to keep together.

en.name: Barbell Floor Press
setup: Set the bar in a rack at a height you can reach while lying on the floor.
Lie under it with your knees bent and grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
execution: Lower the bar until your upper arms rest on the floor.
Pause briefly, then press the bar back up.
mistakes: Bouncing the elbows off the floor.
Letting the bar drift toward the face.

en.name: Band Chest Fly
setup: Anchor a band behind you at chest height and hold one end in each hand.
Step forward until the band is taut, arms open and elbows soft.
execution: Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide arc.
Open your arms slowly back to the start.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a press.
Letting the band pull the arms behind the body.

en.name: Suspension Trainer Chest Press
setup: Face away from the anchor and hold the handles at chest height.
Walk your feet back to lean forward, body straight.
execution: Lower your chest between the handles by bending your elbows.
Press back to straight arms without letting the straps rub your arms.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag.
Letting the handles drift wide apart.

en.name: Archer Push-Up
setup: Set your hands very wide in a push-up position.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
execution: Lower toward one hand while the other arm stays nearly straight.
Push back to the middle, then repeat on the other side.
mistakes: Twisting the hips.
Bending both arms equally, which turns it into a wide push-up.
cues: Work arm bends, helper arm straight

en.name: Ring Dip
setup: Set the rings at about hip height and jump into a support with straight arms.
Press the rings against your sides and turn your palms slightly forward.
execution: Lower until your shoulders are just below your elbows while keeping the rings close.
Press back up to a locked support.
mistakes: Letting the rings drift away from the body.
Dropping too deep before the shoulders are ready.
en.safety: Build a steady ring support hold and solid bar dips before trying ring dips.

en.name: Scapular Push-Up
setup: Get into a push-up position with straight arms.
Set your hands under your shoulders and brace your core.
execution: Keeping your arms locked, let your chest sink so your shoulder blades come together.
Push the floor away so your upper back rounds and the shoulder blades spread.
mistakes: Bending the elbows.
Letting the hips sag.

en.name: Ring Push-Up
setup: Set the rings a few centimetres off the floor and grip them in a push-up position.
Keep the rings under your shoulders.
execution: Lower your chest between the rings while keeping them steady.
Press back up and turn the palms slightly forward at the top.
mistakes: Letting the rings slide out to the sides.
Letting the hips sag.

en.name: Svend Press
setup: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Press two small plates together between your palms at chest height.
execution: Squeeze the plates hard and push them straight forward until your arms are extended.
Bring them back to your chest without easing the squeeze.
mistakes: Letting the squeeze relax during the rep.
Leaning back.

en.name: One-Arm Push-Up
setup: Set your feet wider than your hips and place one hand under your chest.
Put the other hand behind your back and brace hard.
execution: Lower your chest toward the floor without twisting.
Press back up to a straight arm.
mistakes: Rotating the hips toward the floor.
Shortening the range.

en.name: Suspension Trainer Fly
setup: Face away from the anchor and hold the handles in front of your chest with straight arms.
Lean forward with your body straight.
execution: Open your arms wide in an arc as your chest moves forward.
Squeeze your chest to bring the handles back together.
mistakes: Bending the elbows too much.
Going so wide that the shoulders are overstretched.
en.safety: Start with a small lean; this exercise loads the shoulders hard.

en.name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
setup: Place your hands at your waist with your fingers turned outward.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands and lock your body straight.
execution: Lower your chest toward the floor while keeping the forward lean.
Press back up without losing the lean.
mistakes: Letting the shoulders drift back over the hands.
Letting the hips sag.
en.safety: Build up slowly; the forward lean puts heavy strain on wrists and elbows.
